# TERA Companion Guide

> A comprehensive guide to Pets and Partners in TERA.

---

## 1. Companion Basics

![Companion Basics UI](data:image/webp;base64,)

Companions come in two forms: **Pets** and **Partners**.

| Type    | Skills   | Abilities    | Notes                         |
| ------- | -------- | ------------ | ----------------------------- |
| Pet     | None     | Usually none | Can be evolved into a Partner |
| Partner | 2 skills | Usually none | Upgraded form of a Pet        |

Both types have **levels** (Pets) or **grades** (Partners) that increase their total **Energy/Stamina** — which determines how long they can stay summoned between feedings or receiving gifts.

> **Tip:** Open the Companion menu with the default keybinding `Shift+P`.

---

## 2. Acquiring Companions

![Acquisition — Achievements & Legacy Essence](data:image/webp;base64,)

There are several ways to obtain companions:

| Method             | Yield                | Notes                                                                     |
| ------------------ | -------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Achievements**   | ~20 Pets, 0 Partners | Earn through in-game achievements                                         |
| **Dungeons**       | Rare Pet drop        | Occasionally drops a Pet with the *Auto-Potion (HP/MP) Large* ability     |
| **Evolution**      | 1 Partner            | Combine 2 Pets, or use an Evolution Stone                                 |
| **Legacy Essence** | 1 Pet per 10 Essence | Right-click Legacy Essence to use                                         |
| **Pet Adventures** | Rare Partner         | Partners obtained this way have no Abilities or Skills (useful as fodder) |
| **Special Events** | Varies               | Pets & Partners vary by event                                             |
| **Tera Store**     | Varies               | Prices vary                                                               |

> **Legacy Essence** is a Rare Miscellaneous item, usable at level 1+. It cannot be traded or sold and cannot be stored in the guild bank. Sources include Gossamer Vault (Hard) and Lv.65+ monsters in hunting zones.

---

## 3. Leveling & Promoting

![Leveling and Promoting UI](data:image/webp;base64,)

### Leveling Pets

- Pets have a **maximum level of 10**.
- A pet's level affects the success rate when combining two pets into a Partner.
- To level up: select the pet, press **Grow**, drag & drop Pet Candies and/or crafting/upgrade materials into the item slots, then press **Grow** again.

### Promoting Partners

- Partners have a **maximum grade of 10**.
- Unlike pets, you feed a Partner **other Partners** as fodder — this costs **2,000 gold** per promotion.
- A Partner's grade always increases by **1**, and gains a random amount of Fellowship based on the fodder Partner's grade.
- To promote: select the Partner, press **Promote**, select the fodder Partner, then press **Promote** again.

---

## 4. Pet Evolution

![Evolution UI and Alchemy crafting](data:image/webp;base64,)

Evolving a Pet turns it into a Partner. There are two methods:

### Method 1 — Combining Two Pets

- Place two Pets in the **Combine** slots and pay **2,000 gold**.
- Success rate is based on the Pets' levels.
- Two **Level 10** Pets combined has a reported **100% success rate**.

### Method 2 — Evolution Stone

- Use an **Evolution Stone** on a single Pet (requires the pet to be Level 10) along with **2,000 gold**.
- The community reports an approximate **20% success rate**.
- If evolution fails, the Pet's level decreases by 1.
- Evolution Stones (called **Evolution Core** in the Alchemy crafting menu) can be obtained by **crafting** (requires Master-level Alchemy) or via the **Broker**.

> **Crafting an Evolution Core** requires: Harmony Grass ×5, Norsteel Ingot ×15, Galborne Ingot ×15. Crafting Skill 800 (Master) required.

---

## 5. Companion Abilities

![Partner Training UI](data:image/webp;base64,)

![Partner with abilities active (1)](data:image/webp;base64,)

![Partner with abilities active (2)](data:image/png;base64,)

Companions can hold passive and active abilities. Abilities can be transferred to a Partner via the **Train** function — select a Pet that has the desired ability and it will be transferred to the Partner.

| Ability                     | Effect                                                                                        |
| --------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Auto-Loot**               | Your pet automatically picks up loot and gold dropped by mobs                                 |
| **Auto-Gold**               | Your pet automatically picks up only gold dropped by mobs                                     |
| **Auto-Gather**             | When close enough, your pet automatically gathers nearby resource nodes                       |
| **Special Storage**         | Grants an additional **72-slot storage page** accessible anywhere while companion is summoned |
| **Auto-Potion (HP) Small**  | Automatically uses a small HP potion to restore health                                        |
| **Auto-Potion (MP) Small**  | Automatically uses a small MP potion to restore mana                                          |
| **Auto-Potion (HP) Medium** | Automatically uses a medium HP potion to restore health                                       |
| **Auto-Potion (MP) Medium** | Automatically uses a medium MP potion to restore mana                                         |
| **Auto-Potion (HP) Large**  | Automatically uses a large HP potion to restore health                                        |
| **Auto-Potion (MP) Large**  | Automatically uses a large MP potion to restore mana                                          |

> **Note:** Auto-Potion abilities marked as **Switch** can be toggled on/off. Abilities marked **Active** are always active while the companion is summoned.

## 6. Pet Adventures

![Pet Adventure — Instant Complete](data:image/webp;base64,)

![Pet Adventure — World Tree conditions and rewards](data:image/webp;base64,)

![Pet Adventure — Companions list during adventure](data:image/png;base64,)

Partners can be sent on **Pet Adventures** to earn rewards passively. Up to **3 Partners** can be on adventures simultaneously.

### Available Adventures

| Adventure         | Notable Rewards                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Red Refuge        | Varies                                                                                                                               |
| Antaroth's Abyss  | Varies                                                                                                                               |
| Corrupted Skynest | Varies                                                                                                                               |
| Rift's Edge       | Varies                                                                                                                               |
| **World Tree**    | Kelsaik Treasure Bag, Weapon/Armor Darkshards, Argog's Claws, Argog's Weapon Skin, Processed Ore, Annealed Darkshard Cohesion Arcane |

### World Tree Adventure Conditions

To succeed at World Tree, your Partner must meet these conditions:

| Stat     | Minimum      |
| -------- | ------------ |
| Uncommon | 4 or above   |
| Rare     | 3 or above   |
| Superior | 2 or above   |
| Stamina  | 30% or above |

### World Tree Possible Rewards

- Skill Advancement/Optimization Scroll
- Skill Advancement Tome
- [Rare] Halidom/Relic I
- Dark Shard Weapon Feedstock
- Dark Shard Armor Feedstock
- Dark Shard Cohesion Arcane
- Partner: Dopey Cocomin
- Argog's Weapon Crate

> **Tip:** You can use an **Instant Complete** item to finish an adventure immediately. Adventures run on a timer, visible in the Partner Adventure panel. A Partner sent on an adventure will show as *Adventuring* in the Companion List.
